instructions: Fill a separate copy and pass --reviews; this generated template is always pending, never adoption evidence.
Read original source lines and untruncated code/results. IDs refer to the corresponding game/arm deduplicated trajectory.
Prove current-frame crop bounds/origin/row-col/characters, encoded state and downstream consumption; printing or uncalled function definitions do not qualify.
Correct first encoding is confirmation, not prevention. Correction requires an observed wrong prior encoding and changed state; action-before/after must be supported separately.
Record baseline chains too. Inspect stale frame/new-level coordinates, holes/components, color-mask versus physical-footprint distinctions and added read overhead.
At least two candidate games need verified extraction→encoding→consumption chains, with at least one concrete correction/interception and no observed new misuse; score is evaluated separately.
Machine checks validate reference existence, not semantic truth. Explicit reviewer judgment remains necessary.

review_scope.method: Read all available deduplicated trajectory chronology and inspect selected complete code/results against original JSONL IDs and hashes. Parse literal masks/crops and perform independent arithmetic only; no generated Python executed and no game implementation read.
boundaries: This is a four arm/game partial review to merge with the other games, not an independent whole-screen pass decision.
new_misuse_excluded applies to each verified corrected/confirmed chain after correction; it is not a guarantee of bug-free later reasoning or causal attribution to the prompt.
Errors observed and then repaired are classified as error_corrected/intercepted, not automatically as a newly treatment-caused misuse. Unresolved later rule-model cases remain non-qualifying.

Action counters are request snapshots, not zero-based benchmark indexes. Raw response history may omit a final tool call until another request; terminal outcomes use explicit returned level_completed for each cited chain.

summary_zh: 两个候选游戏均有真实纠错并实际消费：ft09第3关漏目标与误坐标修正后过关；tr87第2关修正重复列偏移/字形维度，第4关在动作前修正Q的列偏移并过关。baseline也自然纠正表示错误；这证明本轮采用链而不证明提示的因果增益。后续ft09第6关、tr87第5关仍未完成，不能把读取或覆盖数当通关收益。
